Container.Name: downtify
Container.Overview: Download music from Spotify and YouTube Music playlists, with optional Soulseek (slskd) and Usenet (Newznab indexer + SABnzbd) audio sources.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Container Port: 8000 (DOWNTIFY_PORT). Map any free host port.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings, databases, cookies.txt — survives image updates.

Config.Name: slskd downloads
Config.Description: Optional: slskd download folder, when using the Soulseek audio source.

Config.Name: SABnzbd complete
Config.Description: Optional: SABnzbd 'Completed Downloads' folder, when using the Usenet audio source. Mount it with the SAME container path SABnzbd uses, or set 'complete_dir' in Downtify's settings to /usenet.

Config.Name: Downtify Port
Config.Description: Internal port Downtify listens on. Keep in sync with the WebUI Port target.

Config.Name: Cookies file
Config.Description: Optional: container path of a YouTube cookies.txt (e.g. /data/cookies.txt) to bypass YouTube's bot check. Can also be uploaded in Settings.

Config.Name: YT player clients
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated yt-dlp player_client override (e.g. android,web_embedded).

Config.Name: YT PO Token
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated PO Tokens in the form client.context+token (e.g. web.gvs+ABC123) to bypass YouTube's bot check.
